title: Verify: Poll error handling unit tests
summary: Unit tests for pull, list, close failures and nil Closer
description: Write backend/worker/internal/poller/poller_errors_test.go reusing the fakes from poller_detect_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: Pull and list failures abort with wrapped errors.
Close failure does not stop other Rounds.
Nil Closer returns an error without panic.

steps.action: Input: fakeGit.pullErr = errBoom. Assert errors.Is(err, errBoom), fakeGit.calls equals []string{"pull"}, fakeCloser.calls empty and Result slices empty. Add a second case with listErr = errBoom asserting errors.Is(err, errBoom) and fakeCloser.calls empty.

Inputs: expired OPEN E1 and E2, fakeCloser.errFor["E1"] = errBoom. Assert errors.Is(err, errBoom), fakeCloser.calls equals []string{"E1","E2"}, Result.Closed equals []string{"E2"} and ClosedNow equals []string{"E2"}.
Input: New with a nil Closer and one expired OPEN Round. Assert err is non-nil, its message contains "no closer configured" and no panic occurs.
